tools.description:
Use this tool when buyers are searching for products and haven't provided a specific shop.
For example:
- "I'm looking for a pair of shoes"
- "Could you find me some blue jeans?"
- "I need a new dress, I'm a size 10 and I like the color blue"

You can also use a saved catalog slug to search using saved catalog filters.

upid.description: The universal product ID (in Base62 encoded format). Provide either upid or variant_id, not both.

_gsid.description: Reference to the Global Search which generated the URL. Optional, and pre-populated in Global Search results.

available_for_sale.description: When true, include only products available for sale. Otherwise, unavailable products may be shown.

context.description: Additional information about the request such as user demographics, mood, location, or other relevant details that could help in tailoring the response appropriately.

limit.description: The maximum number of offers to return for the product.

product_options.description: Product options like color, size, etc.

ships_from.description: The countries to ship from (ISO country code)

ships_to.description: The countries to ship to (ISO country code)

variant_id.description: The Shopify variant ID. Provide either variant_id or upid, not both.

product_id.description: Will force this product to be the first result if no query is provided.
